content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant position at IIT Kanpur is 30 September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Graduate degree in B.Sc., B.A., B.Com, BCA, BBA, or LLB to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant post in the IIT Kanpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Project Assistant post ranges from Rs. 19000 to Rs. 47800.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kanpur Project Assistant recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is P.Rect./IP/DOAD/2026/31.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208016.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for an Ad-hoc job type at IIT Kanpur.
